name: GLM 5.3 on four DGX Sparks: a community K4 quant picked from 12 tested, closer to BF16 than NVIDIA's NVFP4 and smaller
title: GLM 5.3 on four DGX Sparks: a community K4 quant picked from 12 tested, closer to BF16 than NVIDIA's NVFP4 and smaller
summary: After 12 quantizations tested over three days, MiaAI Lab's pick for GLM 5.3 on four Sparks is a K4 quant that sits closer to BF16 than NVIDIA's NVFP4 and leaves room for a larger KV cache. The Hugging Face link is in the original thread.
